# Scopus API keys for the collection stages (stages 1 and 2).
#
# Do NOT edit this file in place and do NOT commit it.  Copy it first:
#
#     copy config\scopus_keys.example.txt config\scopus_keys.txt
#
# then put one 32-character Scopus API key per line.  Lines starting with '#'
# and blank lines are ignored.  Keys can also be supplied through the
# SCOPUS_API_KEYS environment variable (comma or whitespace separated), which
# takes precedence over this file.
#
# Keys are rotated automatically when several are given, which is what makes a
# large batch collection finish quickly.  Request a key at
# https://dev.elsevier.com/apikey/manage
#
# Optional: an institutional token, if your subscription needs one.
# SCOPUS_INST_TOKEN
